themes.strategy: Single :root palette overridden wholesale under @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark). Every token keeps its name and its role across themes; no component redefines a color per theme. colorMeta.<token>.dark carries the dark-theme value of each token.

neutral.purpose: The color of a thing that was not measured: the dot for document / idle / none / unknown, and the input hover border.

slate.purpose: Informational chrome that is deliberately not a health verdict.

display.purpose: The current view's name in the top bar. One per screen; visually hidden below 840px.

headline.purpose: The detail pane's subject, in monospace because it is an identifier read off disk.

body.purpose: Default text, buttons, tabs, row names, empty states. Prose caps at 72ch.

caption.purpose: Subtitles, footers, chips, stats, form labels, and all monospaced evidence.

label.purpose: Uppercase 0.07em nav-group headings and sticky list-group headers.

mono.purpose: Names, paths, sizes, counts, evidence lines, generated commands, diffs. Never a costume for 'technical'.

typeScale.note: Exactly five steps. The body sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums globally.

shadows.name: toast-float
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system. The toast is fixed over the page and must read as detached.

shadows.name: selection-marker
shadows.purpose: A 1px accent bar inside the left edge of a selected row or toggled button. A marker drawn with the shadow property, not elevation.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Shared by every focusable element. Offset drops to 0 on text fields so the field does not appear to grow.

motion.name: toast-fade
motion.purpose: The only transition in the product. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. Nothing animates on hover, selection, tab change or data refresh.

breakpoints.name: single
breakpoints.purpose: The only breakpoint. Above: 212px sidebar nav and two side-by-side panes. Below: horizontal nav scroller with hidden scrollbar, stacked panes, hidden display title, and touch targets grown to 40px (tabs, rows) and 36px (buttons).

layout.topBar: min-height 56px (52px below 840px), 6px/16px padding, 1px bottom rule, panel ground
layout.sidebar: --nav: 212px, four labeled groups (Status / Catalog / Projects / System)
layout.content: grid minmax(300px,1.1fr) / minmax(290px,1fr) — list and detail, 1px rule between
layout.rowDensity: 34px at rest, 40px on touch; 8px dot column fixed first so dots align down the list

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Every action except the one primary per pane. Bordered at rest so a control is distinguishable from text without hovering.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: 14px/1.5 var(--sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif); padding: 6px 12px; min-height: 32px; border-radius: var(--r,6px); border: 1px solid var(--line,#E2E5E8); background: var(--panel,#fff); color: var(--ink,#0B0D0F); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--hover,#F0F1F3); border-color: var(--neutral,#AEB3B9); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent,#0B5FCE); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn[disabled] { opacity: .45; cursor: default; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One per pane or dialog. Solid accent; hover deepens rather than lifts.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 14px/1.5 var(--sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif); font-weight: 500; padding: 6px 12px; min-height: 32px; border-radius: var(--r,6px); border: 1px solid var(--accent,#0B5FCE); background: var(--accent,#0B5FCE); color: var(--on-accent,#fff); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-ink,#0A4FA8); border-color: var(--accent-ink,#0A4FA8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent,#0B5FCE); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Toggled Button
components.description: A button holding an on state (focus filter, selected version). Carries the same inset accent marker as a selected row, so 'active' reads identically in both places.
components.css: .ds-btn-on { font: 14px/1.5 var(--sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif); font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 12px; min-height: 32px; border-radius: var(--r,6px); border: 1px solid var(--accent-soft,#E7EFFC); background: var(--accent-soft,#E7EFFC); color: var(--accent-ink,#0A4FA8); box-shadow: inset 1px 0 0 var(--accent,#0B5FCE); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-on:hover { border-color: var(--accent,#0B5FCE); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped list filter. Chips filter; they never trigger an action.
components.css: .ds-chip { font: 12.5px/1.25 var(--sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 99px; border: 1px solid var(--line,#E2E5E8); background: none; color: var(--dim,#5E636A); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--ink,#0B0D0F); border-color: var(--neutral,#AEB3B9); } .ds-chip.ds-on { background: var(--accent-soft,#E7EFFC); color: var(--accent-ink,#0A4FA8); border-color: var(--accent-soft,#E7EFFC); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: The readable twin of the status dot: always contains a word, never a second dot. Sans face inside an otherwise monospaced heading.
components.html: ok warnings invalid document
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; font: 500 11px/1.4 var(--sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 99px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pill.ds-ok { background: var(--moss-soft,#E1F2E7); color: var(--moss,#1C7A3E); } .ds-pill.ds-warn { background: var(--amber-soft,#F9EDD6); color: var(--amber,#875806); } .ds-pill.ds-bad { background: var(--rust-soft,#FAE4E1); color: var(--rust,#B22417); } .ds-pill.ds-none { background: var(--line,#E2E5E8); color: var(--dim,#5E636A); }

components.name: List Row
components.description: The product's densest and most repeated surface: 8px status dot, monospace name, right-aligned dim metadata, on a 1px-ruled 34px band. Selected adds the blue wash and the inset accent marker.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8px 1fr auto; gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 6px 14px; min-height: 34px; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line,#E2E5E8); color: var(--ink,#0B0D0F); cursor: pointer; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--hover,#F0F1F3); } .ds-row.ds-sel { background: var(--accent-soft,#E7EFFC); box-shadow: inset 1px 0 0 var(--accent,#0B5FCE); } .ds-row.ds-sel .ds-n, .ds-row.ds-sel .ds-c { color: var(--accent-ink,#0A4FA8); } .ds-row.ds-sel .ds-n { font-weight: 600; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex: none; } .ds-d-ok { background: var(--moss,#1C7A3E); } .ds-d-warn { background: var(--amber,#875806); } .ds-d-bad { background: var(--rust,#B22417); } .ds-d-unknown { background: var(--neutral,#AEB3B9); } .ds-row .ds-n { font-family: var(--mono,ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace); font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: -.01em; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row .ds-c { color: var(--dim,#5E636A); font-size: 12.5px; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Grouped sidebar navigation above 840px; the same markup becomes a horizontal scroller below it. The active item carries aria-current="page".
components.html: Status
components.css: .ds-nav { padding: 12px 8px; } .ds-navLabel { display: block; padding: 0 10px 6px; font: 600 11px/1.4 var(--sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif); letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--dim,#5E636A); } .ds-tab { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; font: 14px/1.5 var(--sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif); background: none; border: 1px solid transparent; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: var(--r,6px); color: var(--dim,#5E636A); margin-bottom: 1px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink,#0B0D0F); background: var(--hover,#F0F1F3); } .ds-tab.ds-on { color: var(--accent-ink,#0A4FA8); background: var(--accent-soft,#E7EFFC); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The list filter field. Focus turns the border accent and sits the ring flush so the field does not appear to grow.
components.css: .ds-input { font: 14px/1.5 var(--sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif); color: var(--ink,#0B0D0F); background: var(--panel,#fff); border: 1px solid var(--line,#E2E5E8); border-radius: var(--r,6px); padding: 6px 10px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--dim,#5E636A); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--neutral,#AEB3B9); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent,#0B5FCE); outline: 2px solid var(--accent,#0B5FCE); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: State Box
components.description: A statement about state: soft tint, matching text color, no border. Slate is the informational variant, deliberately outside the green/amber/red vocabulary so an explanation is never read as a verdict.
components.html:
An agent is working in alpha right now. You can read, but editing is blocked until it finishes.
Agents from alpha, refreshed every second.
components.css: .ds-box { font: 14px/1.5 var(--sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif); padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: var(--r,6px); margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-box.ds-warn { background: var(--amber-soft,#F9EDD6); color: var(--amber,#875806); } .ds-box.ds-bad { background: var(--rust-soft,#FAE4E1); color: var(--rust,#B22417); } .ds-box.ds-info { background: var(--slate-soft,#ECF0F4); color: var(--slate,#3B4A5B); }

components.name: Evidence Block
components.description: Measured lines and generated commands. Scrolls sideways instead of wrapping so a line stays comparable to the line above it. cabina generates the command; it never runs it.
components.css: .ds-lines { font-family: var(--mono,ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.5; white-space: pre; overflow-x: auto; background: var(--bg,#F6F7F8); border: 1px solid var(--line,#E2E5E8); border-radius: var(--r,6px); padding: 8px 12px; margin: 0; }

components.name: Legend
components.description: Decodes the status dots for the current view, rebuilt per view and hidden when a view has none. Without it the densest signal on the screen is unreadable without clicking a row.
components.html: okwarningsinvalidno state
components.css: .ds-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px 14px; padding: 6px 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line,#E2E5E8); font: 11px/1.4 var(--sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif); color: var(--dim,#5E636A); background: var(--panel,#fff); } .ds-legend i { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-style: normal; }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Inverted confirmation, fixed over the page. The only element in the product with a shadow and the only one with a transition.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-block; background: var(--ink,#0B0D0F); color: var(--bg,#F6F7F8); padding: 9px 14px; border-radius: var(--r,6px); font-size: 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.18); max-width: 90vw; transition: opacity .2s; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-toast { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Project-OS looks like what it is: an instrument that reports measurements taken from the operator's own machine. Instruments do not decorate their readings. The entire visual budget goes into making a dense screen legible for an hour at a time — a near-monochrome ground of paper white and near-black, hairline rules instead of boxes, and exactly one saturated color for interaction. Everything that is colored is colored because it means something.

Hierarchy comes from three devices only: type weight, spacing, and a status dot. There are no cards floating over the page, no gradients, no glyph icons, no illustration. The one shadow in the system belongs to the toast, which floats over the page by definition. Depth is tonal instead — panel (#FFFFFF) sits on bg (#F6F7F8) and the seam between them is a 1px line. In dark mode the same relationship inverts (#131518 on #0C0D0F) and nothing else about the system changes.

The quality bar named in PRODUCT.md is Vercel's radical neutrality next to Grafana's observability-grade density; the failure mode named there is "generic template." The build resolves that tension by refusing every decorative device the template offers and spending the savings on status legibility: four semantic hues, each with a soft companion tint, used only to report state.
keyCharacteristics: Near-monochrome ground; one interaction accent (blue); three status hues plus a neutral gray.
System font stack, no webfonts, no network — the product must work fully offline.
Tabular numerals globally, so counts do not jitter as they refresh.
Five type sizes total (11 / 12.5 / 14 / 18 / 22px). No sixth.
Flat by construction: one shadow in the whole system.
Monospace marks what was measured; prose stays in the sans face.
Unknown is written as words, never drawn as a zero or a colored state.

rules.name: The State-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Moss, amber and rust are reserved for measured state. They may never be used for emphasis, branding, category, or decoration. If a hue would appear on something that is not a reading, it is the wrong hue.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only interaction color and the only accent. Selection, focus, active nav and the primary action all speak with it; nothing else does.

rules.name: The Unknown-Is-Gray Rule
rules.body: A thing that was not measured takes the neutral gray dot and says so in words ("n/a", "size not measured", "never recorded"). Unknown never borrows moss, amber or rust, and it is never rendered as 0.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Measurement Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks something the product measured or generated: a name on disk, a path, a size, a count, an evidence line, a generated command, a diff. Explanatory prose stays in the sans face even inside a technical panel. The build enforces this at runtime — evidenceHtml() splits a finding into prose and measured lines and only monospaces the latter. Monospace is never a costume for "this feels technical."

rules.name: The Five-Step Rule
rules.body: The ramp is exactly five sizes (11 / 12.5 / 14 / 18 / 22px), exposed as --fs-1 through --fs-5. A new surface picks one of the five; it does not introduce a sixth, and it does not hardcode a px value that a step already covers.

rules.name: The Two-Pane Rule
rules.body: Every view is the same shell: a list that carries clickable headlines and a detail pane that carries the evidence. A new view adopts the shell; it does not invent a layout.

rules.name: The 840 Rule
rules.body: One breakpoint, at 840px. Above it: sidebar nav, two panes side by side. Below it: the nav becomes a horizontal scroller with its scrollbar hidden, the panes stack with a rule between them, the display title is visually hidden, and every target grows (tabs and rows to 40px, buttons to 36px). There is no second breakpoint and no tablet-specific case.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and flat on hover. Hover changes the ground color (hover) or a border color (neutral); it never adds a shadow, a lift, or a scale. If a new element seems to need elevation, it needs a hairline or a tonal step instead.

rules.name: The Motion-Free Rule
rules.body: The product has one transition — the toast's 200ms opacity fade, itself disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. Nothing animates on hover, selection, tab change or data refresh. A screen that repaints once a second must not also be in motion.

dos: Do carry every color through its CSS custom property. Both themes are defined once on :root; a literal hex in a new rule is a bug in dark mode.
Do pick one of the five type steps (--fs-1…--fs-5) and one radius (6px, or 99px for a token shape).
Do pair every status color with a word — a pill, a legend entry, or the count it labels. Color is never the only channel.
Do write unknown as text ("n/a", "size not measured", "never recorded") and give it the neutral gray dot.
Do keep exactly one primary button per pane or dialog; every other action is a default button. The build holds to this across all eleven of its primary buttons.
Do monospace measured values and generated commands, and leave explanation in the sans face.
Do show a generated command in an evidence block for the user to read and run. cabina never runs it.
Do let long values ellipsize, and break paths after a separator.
donts: Don't use moss, amber or rust for anything that is not a measured state — not for emphasis, not for a category, not for branding.
Don't introduce a second accent, or restyle the accent per view.
Don't add a resting shadow, a hover lift, or any transition beyond the toast's fade. One shadow exists and it belongs to the toast.
Don't render an unmeasured value as 0, an empty bar, or a green check.
Don't add glyph icons or an icon font. The 8px status dot is the icon set, and the product ships offline with no external assets.
Don't outline a control in a status color; a state is a fill plus a text color.
Don't wrap an evidence line. It scrolls sideways so it stays comparable to the line above it.
Don't add a breakpoint. There is one, at 840px.
Don't style a control with an inline style attribute when a class exists; the few that remain in the build are debt, not a pattern.
